features.quote: 3 parties until dawn in 3 different rooms
features.rationale: The description states that the parties take place in three different rooms, so there is more than one dance room.
The event offers 45 hours of dance classes, which are workshops within the event.
A pre-party is scheduled before the main Friday open party.
